_comment: Copy to profile.json and fill in. profile.json is gitignored: it is the only place the sender's identity lives, so the code can be published without publishing a CV.
name: Jane Doe
_common_ground: What you share with people worth finding at a firm, beyond the schools, languages and employers already in resume_bank.json. kind is one of heritage, group, school, language, sport, hobby, employer, place; terms are the phrases a bio would use (the label if omitted); search is what a hand-run LinkedIn search should use. Matched only against what a person states about themselves, never a name.
